senses.gloss:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (रटति रटयति)
To speak.

mfn. (-टन्-टन्ती-टत्)
Speaking.
E.
रट to speak, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Speaking.
E.
रट, and ल्युट् aff.

f. (-न्ती)
The fourteenth of the dark half of Māgha, when bathing is enjoined.
E.
रट to speak, झच्^1. aff., the waters speak.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161212. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batches 309-312. note: There is a जश् affix, but I think झच् is meant here.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Spoken, said.
n. (-तं)
The roaring of flame.
E.
रट to speak, aff. क्त.

f. (-टिः)
War, battle.
E.
रट to speak, to sound, aff. इञ्.
